note: Protocol negative cases. No renderer is run in this PR. Expected outcomes are the contract later probes must meet.

cases.expectedOutcome: Schema validation fails with a message that names the missing required field. No render starts.

cases.setup: Ask a backend to render a plan that requests a feature it does not declare, for example a live-photo motion alternative when the backend has no pair handling.
cases.expectedOutcome: The backend refuses before render. The refusal names the unsupported feature. No output receipt is written.

cases.setup: Delete one source listed in the plan, then ask the backend to build at plan time.
cases.expectedOutcome: Plan-time error. The missing source id and digest are named. No silent skip.

cases.setup: Show a preview for plan digest A, then edit the plan to digest B without rebuilding the preview.
cases.expectedOutcome: The preview is marked not current against the newer plan digest. It cannot stand in for approval of B.

cases.setup: Kill the worker during fixture L, then reopen and read the reconcile report.
cases.expectedOutcome: Exactly one interrupted attempt. Retry resumes from cached clean segments when those segments exist. No duplicate completed output.
